# Stained Glass — Originating Light, Spectrum, Panes, Seams, and Returning Recognition

<a id="stained-glass-whole"></a>
## #0 — Light entering a made aperture

Light enters a room through a window assembled from differently coloured panes. The panes give it determinate passages; the lead holds their boundaries; an image falls into the interior where someone can encounter it. Sun, aperture, glass, seams, room and viewer belong to this event. The visible colour carries the work of relations which the colour alone cannot display completely.

This is Frank Taylor's authored Mytheme of constructing from diaphaneity: composing a work so that its originating relation becomes perceptible through the differences of its materials. Its whole is the optical movement, from originating light through differentiated transmission to situated appearance and returning recognition. No particular historical window, cathedral programme or sacred iconography is being reconstructed. The source of the composition is the stained-glass contribution and its explicit correction, where the window becomes a way of making the argument, with each source's distinct office active in the result.

The originating light has priority over the projected image. The viewer nevertheless encounters the image first and follows its differences back toward what made them possible. This asymmetry gives the whole its direction: what is prior in being can be later in recognition. **Bimba** names the Original order; **pratibimba** names its determinate reflected or refracted display. The room's image receives the latter office. Neither the viewer nor the maker supplies the Original by finishing the picture.

<a id="stained-glass-spectrum"></a>
## #1 — The spectrum implicated in the light

The white light carries plenitude. Its apparent unity holds the possibility of differentiated colour, together with the relations through which the colours belong to one field. Within Taylor's optic, this full ordered spectrum figures **QL**. QL belongs immanently to the originating light as its harmonic articulation. The pane gives a difference a passage; it does not first create the capacity for difference in a contentless source.

In [the native theorem field](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md), the same relation unfolds formally. Its parent phases bear the complete positional field in inverse orientations. The First Spanda's source-to-expression and return-to-recognition movements are joined through their interference term; the achieved relation can turn back through what generated it. The optical whole makes this implicated fullness and differentiated return visible. It leaves the equations' derivation in the theorem field.

QL's sixfold body and eight-determination traversal therefore remain distinct from the number of panes in the window. The eightfold follows bare relationality, conscious circumstance, question/assertion, withdrawal/extension, determining capacity/instance, personed context, differential horizon and the return-switch. Its native `X/x` names determining capacity and local instance before any psychic reading. None of these relations requires a pane to receive a permanent number, tradition or colour. The window's local sixfold follows what the light, construction and encounter actually do.

The spectral language is Taylor's formal/Mytheme articulation. Modern spectral optics and Śaiva metaphysics retain their own historical objects and warrants; physical light gives this image its sensuous body rather than deriving QL.

<a id="stained-glass-panes-seams"></a>
## #2 — Colour acquires a passage; the joins stay visible

Each pane has a material, density, colour and angle. Its placement permits some transmission, bends or colours what passes, and leaves something obstructed. The maker joins these different capacities into an aperture. Colour gives disclosure a definite form; removing every difference in pursuit of neutrality would also remove the particular transformations through which the composition becomes articulate.

The original quilt distinguishes this construction from an opaque mosaic. A mosaic arranges fragments into a surface image; the window works through transmission and obstruction as well as arrangement. Its material joins participate in how light enters. This is why the window carries the method's construction from the beginning: choosing and joining its materials already determines how the source can become visible.

The lead cames carry the joins. They hold neighbouring panes in relation while marking where one passage ends and another begins. In the epistemic construction, those seams retain source provenance, historical discontinuity, translation limits, contradiction and changes of register. A passage through a mathematical derivation differs from a passage through a lived encounter or a historical text. Their conjunction becomes informative when a reader can follow where the warrant changes and what survives the crossing.

These panes, media, angles, densities, joins and declared relations figure [MEF](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework.md), the meta-epistemic operation of refraction: a lens changes a question, a permissible inference or an act of judgment, while keeping its conditions inspectable. A source enters because its particular operation changes what the whole can disclose. Merely placing its name beside another name would leave that operation undone.

The lead holds the refractive apparatus together; QL belongs to the light's harmonic order. MEF makes distinctions available within that order. The panes' crossings keep each source and its transformation examinable through the display instead of assigning the apparatus an authority exterior to the light.

<a id="stained-glass-projection"></a>
## #3 — The image appears inside the room

The coloured display is produced through the relation of light and made aperture. It appears in an interior and is encountered from a position. Looking only at the glass would recover its coloured matter and arrangement while missing the event of transmission. Looking only at the cast image would conceal the glass, its joins and its placement. The whole holds both the constructed opening and the appearance it makes possible.

This situated image is **pratibimba**. A source-reading, claim, model or essay section can receive the same office when it displays an originating relation under determinate conditions. Its particularity makes something available to another person. Its danger begins when that availability becomes a claim to possess the source, as if what falls here exhausted what can appear.

The viewer is implicated in the display's appearing. Body, position, attention and concern enter what is seen and what becomes significant. Taylor's [P5 — Gebser](<../../../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/P5 - Gebser.md>) **sources** the authorial demand for an invested reading of text and subtext. Seeing through includes being with what is seen and answerable to the situation's outcome. [Contextual transparency](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) occurs through this whole optical relation: the display shows a world and makes its conditions readable to the viewer participating in it.

A finished image can become a surrogate standard: other disclosures are admitted only where they fit it. The window keeps its conditions available so that this reversal can be recognised. The question can then pass from the beauty or persuasiveness of the present picture to the light, exclusions and construction through which it gained that force. Taylor's Father/standard interpretation follows the danger of a projection taking its source's office; that interpretation has its authorial attribution, distinct from Gebser's historical account.

<a id="stained-glass-changing-context"></a>
## #4 — Changing light discloses the construction

As sun, pane, angle, room and viewer change, the projected colour changes. A later display makes visible a region previously obscured. Repositioning or changing a lens can reveal a difference another material could not transmit, or expose an aberration the first view concealed. The changing display gives the reader something to compare: which condition changed, which relation persisted, which difference belongs to the lens, and where the earlier account failed.

The order recognisable across these transformations belongs to Bimba/QL; the successive appearances remain pratibimbas. Recognition neither averages their differences away nor adds them into a final picture. A contradiction can mark different questions or a failed transition, as well as an error requiring correction. Its exact location matters. The coordinated display makes more of its originating relation legible because the transformations remain available to inspection.

The `180°→360°` movement names Taylor's contextual turn. The first-, second- and third-person positions cease to claim isolated completeness as their joint conditions become available. The viewer remains situated. The native account distinguishes changing a whole perspective from recognising the field which permits more than one perspective; context gives the positions and their transformations a co-present relation. Gebser's historical account of perspective and aperspectivity **historicises** that pressure through his [source house](../../../../episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin.md), especially its paraphrase map at pp.1–3, 11–21 and 255–58. The geometry and its QL reckoning remain authorial.

<a id="stained-glass-atlas-complement"></a>
The atlas carries a complementary discipline. Its charts specify local domains and transitions on overlaps, including obstructions to composition. Stained glass gives this plurality its lived optical body: transmission, colouring, interruption, a made aperture and a changing interior display. [Differential placing](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) makes domains, orientations and paths mutually determining; a [world-atlas](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) states the transitions through which differently situated views can meet. A chart-transition is not light passing through glass. Each whole retains the operation the other cannot perform.

Taylor's [Symbolon Dynamics](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md) **sources** a further distinction within this complement: an atlas coordinates partial disclosures, while an attractor organises trajectories in a dynamical field. Moving among readings can change the interpreter and the future possibilities of interpretation. It does not turn the window's panes into mathematically defined attractor basins.

<a id="stained-glass-return"></a>
## #5→0 — Recognition returns to the aperture

[Taylor's Neumann encounter](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-paper-eightfold) differentiates source, articulation and recognition. Here light, made passages and the changed viewer enact that relation optically: a determinate image becomes readable through what gave it form. Its cultural home is the authorial composition; its narrated room is unspecified geographically. Changing illumination and the viewer’s return are the image’s temporal movement, distinct from the dates of the quilt and its source witnesses.

The viewer returns to the window with a changed understanding of the image. What first appeared as a self-contained pattern now discloses the source, selected passages and boundaries of its appearing. The image remains determinate; recognition gives that determinacy a return. A seam can be examined, a source reread, a translation qualified, a lens repositioned, an exclusion allowed to affect the next judgment. The work of composition continues through what its own display has made perceptible.

The Original remains prior throughout this movement. Within a declared Context Frame, an achieved map can genuinely serve as Bimba—the local original or reference field—for situated readings which occupy the Pratibimba office. The same map remains pratibimba relative to its wider sources. The [local Bimba relation](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) gives reference a contextual office. In its [recursive use](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/bimba-pratibimba.md#recursive-office), comparison and correction can reach a situated reading, the relation between reference fields, or the local Bimba itself. An essay section can carry the whole relational movement from its own angle without repeating every other section's content. QL's native recursion supplies that capacity; the optical composition gives it a sensuous office. A technical harness preserves some conditions of a refraction—source, permission, transformation, consequence and review—so that the result can return through them. Its infrastructural office does not make it the Original or exhaust the world which sustains it.

<a id="stained-glass-source-boundaries"></a>
### The luminous image and its historical limits

[Dyczkowski's source house](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration.md) **qualifies** the optical reading through its source-matched transcript. Its p.65 lattice-window image gives a neighbouring account of light appearing diverse through limiting conditions. On pp.66–68, the mirror analogy expressly loses the external object which ordinary reflection requires: in the Śaiva account, the power generating the universe also hosts its appearing. On pp.69–70, an inert mirror or crystal can display without knowing; Vimarśa names the self-apprehending power inseparable from Prakāśa. The sun outside this authored window therefore supplies no warrant for a metaphysical source outside Consciousness, and the glass supplies no substitute for reflective awareness.

[Prakāśa–Vimarśa](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) develops self-apprehending appearing in its metaphysical register. [Singh's Abhinavagupta source house](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana.md) **qualifies** the textual route: introduction, translation and commentary retain separate attribution, and notebook passages are not promoted here into edition-verified quotations. The window remains Taylor's composition, even where a traditional image gives it a precise neighbouring relation.

[Bohm's implicate/explicate source house](../../../../episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order.md) **compares** the process vocabulary of implicated wholeness and differentiated display. The relation is **Resonant with**, not an extraction of QL from Bohm; its unfilled passage ledger supplies no optical or physical proof. Gebser is used through page-specific **Paraphrase / Argued from** his historical method. Dyczkowski supplies **Paraphrased** doctrinal qualification from the local transcript. No new external quotation is claimed. Particular colours and panes remain local optical differences; the composition assigns them no fixed psychological, religious or scientific symbolism.

<a id="stained-glass-returns"></a>
### Returns from the whole

[Diaphaneity](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md) lets the medium become readable through what it discloses. A [world-atlas](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) relates the changing pictures through their conditions and transitions. [MEF](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework.md) keeps each source, angle, transformation and divergence available for their comparison. When a later reading exposes an occlusion, its return can correct the selected source, lens, permission or local reference; an adequate retained relation carries its reasons forward. The next display or judgment inherits that warranted decision.

The [situated aperture](../../../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/05-s01-p4-gebser-diaphaneity.md), [differential placement](../../../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/30-s3-p5-arche-topos.md) and [accountable refraction](../../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/36-s4-p5-mef-prompt-thrownness.md) meet through light, construction and viewer. The window gives those relations a body someone can encounter and revisit. Optical transmission, formal chart transitions, historical interpretations and technical source-return retain the distinct operations by which each contributes to that meeting.
